query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assistant_conversation_sources s JOIN assistant_sessions a ON a.workspace_id=s.workspace_id AND a.id=s.session_id JOIN access_tokens t ON t.id=a.login_id AND t.user_id=a.user_id WHERE s.workspace_id=$1 AND a.user_id=$2 AND a.id<>$3 AND a.state='active' AND a.expires_at>now() AND a.last_seen_at>now()-interval '15 minutes' AND t.expires_at>now()) AS "active!"
